notes.text: Attack ramp time, 0-10 s; ramp curve is shaped by dragging the line.
notes.label: ATTACK

notes.text: Time the envelope stays at peak before decaying, 0-10 s.
notes.label: HOLD

notes.text: Decay ramp time, 0-30 s; ramp curve is shaped by dragging the line.
notes.label: DECAY

notes.text: How much note velocity affects the envelope, 0-100 %.
notes.label: VEL. AMOUNT

notes.text: Velocity response curve, +/-100 %; sets how velocity is remapped.
notes.label: VEL. SENS

notes.text: Cutoff frequency; 20-20,000 Hz
notes.label: CUTOFF

notes.text: Emphasis at cutoff; 0-100%
notes.label: RESONANCE

notes.text: Reference voltage of unit; 1-15
notes.label: VOLTAGE REF

notes.text: High-pass cutoff frequency; 0-100%
notes.label: HP FREQ

notes.text: Cutoff change relative to active note; 0-100%
notes.label: KEY TRACKING

notes.text: Oversampling option; options in order: 2x, 3x, 4x
notes.label: OVERSAMPLE

notes.text: Saturation of OTA stage, on by default
notes.label: OTA SAT.

notes.text: Saturation of op-amp stage, on by default
notes.label: OPA SAT.

notes.text: Takes signal from other tap of filter chain; off by default
notes.label: ALT. OUTPUT

notes.text: Maximum number of harmonics (1-256).
notes.label: MAX PARTIALS

notes.text: Inharmonicity of partials, like stiff strings (0-100%).
notes.label: STRETCH

notes.text: Disturbs the harmonic series; 100% is harmonic (0-800%).
notes.label: DISSONANCE

notes.text: Snaps Dissonance to simple ratios of 25% or 16.67%.
notes.label: QUANTIZE DISSONANCE

notes.text: Shifts all partials by a fixed Hz amount (0-20,000 Hz).
notes.label: FREQ. SHIFT

notes.text: Spectral slope or tilt (+/-100%).
notes.label: SLOPE

notes.text: Balances even and odd harmonic levels (+/-100%).
notes.label: EVEN/ODD

notes.text: Shifts spectrum up to +48 semitones while keeping harmonic relation.
notes.label: HARM. SHIFT

notes.text: Relative frequency of the comb filter on the harmonics (0-100%).
notes.label: FREQUENCY

notes.text: Comb filter cancellation amount (+/-100%).
notes.label: DEPTH

notes.text: Fractional-order filter cutoff (20-20,000 Hz).
notes.label: CUTOFF

notes.text: Filter resonance (0.5-100), available for resonant types.
notes.label: Q

notes.text: Filter slope, from 0.0 to 8.0 (48 dB/octave).
notes.label: ORDER

notes.text: Filter type: LP-BW, BP-BW, HP-BW, LP-Res, BP-Res, or HP-Res.
notes.label: TYPE

notes.text: Number of unison voices (1-3).
notes.label: VOICES

notes.text: Fixed Hz shift of partials creating amplitude beating (0-10 Hz).
notes.label: BEATING

notes.text: Detuning of each unison voice (0-40 cents).
notes.label: DETUNE

notes.text: Offsets unison voice start phases (0-100%).
notes.label: PHASE SPREAD

notes.text: Preserves the fundamental as a reference while processing the spectrum.
notes.label: KEEP BASS

notes.text: Ramp time between amplitude changes (0-1000 ms).
notes.label: RAMP TIME

notes.text: Phase at which partials start on note-on (0-100%).
notes.label: START PHASE

notes.text: Attack time, 0.0001-10 s.
notes.label: ATTACK

notes.text: Decay time, 0.0001-10 s; analog-style decay character.
notes.label: DECAY

notes.text: Sustain level, 0-100 %; ignored in AD mode.
notes.label: SUSTAIN

notes.text: Release time after note-off, 0.0001-10 s; ignored in AD mode.
notes.label: RELEASE

notes.text: Output range controlled by velocity, 0-40 dB; always follows played velocity.
notes.label: DYNAMIC

notes.text: Overshoots attack target, creating a flat plateau at peak, 0-100 %.
notes.label: PUNCH

notes.text: Envelope mode: AD (attack and decay only) or ADSR (all phases).
notes.label: ATTACK/DECAY

notes.text: Retrigger or Legato triggering behaviour.
notes.label: TRIGGER MODE

notes.text: Manual button to fire the envelope on demand; also automatable.
notes.label: TRIGGER

notes.text: Velocity effect on attack time, +/-100 %.
notes.label: VEL>ATTACK

notes.text: Velocity effect on decay time, +/-100 %.
notes.label: VEL>DECAY

notes.text: Key-follow effect on attack time, +/-200 %.
notes.label: KEY>ATTACK

notes.text: Key-follow effect on decay time, +/-200 %.
notes.label: KEY>DECAY

VELOCITY.note: Button that inverts velocity for the attack and decay velocity controls only.
